text: A tall figure in a travel-stained cloak kneels beside you in the ashes.
Stranger: Easy, little one. The bandits are gone.
Stranger: My name is Holloway. I keep the Heroes' Guild. There is nothing left for you here, but there could be something for you there.
No! I have to find my family!
His grip is warm and steady. He lifts you onto his horse without another word.
Holloway: If they live, you'll need to be strong enough to find them.
He lifts you onto his horse anyway, gently.
